riskFreeReference.instrument: US Treasury 10-year par yield / constant maturity
riskFreeReference.selectionRule: Latest available published observation on or before 2026-10-17.
riskFreeReference.classification: Observed market-reference input; a Treasury rate is not company WACC.

crossCheck.status: FRED one observation behind Treasury at retrieval; Treasury Oct 15 also 5.10.

equityRiskPremiumReference.estimator: Damodaran January 2026 implied US ERP using Treasury as risk-free anchor
equityRiskPremiumReference.classification: Dated model/forecast-dependent estimate, not current October ERP or an observed realized return.
equityRiskPremiumReference.caution: Do not mix default-adjusted ERP and unadjusted risk-free conventions or silently apply this January premium to October. Analyst must choose and disclose consistent inputs.

guidance: Use references separately from analyst judgments. Company beta, debt spread, marginal tax, market-value capital weights, geography/country risk and valuation currency still require choices. Never silently set WACC.
